entry_conditions: Peg is visibly retained in a closed grasp and clear of the box; peg axis is near the hole axis; observed hole, peg, TCP, qpos, and qvel are finite. Demonstrated entries at index 1380 have peg z about 0.420-0.428 m, with demo12205 providing a y-offset near 0.160 m.
exit_conditions: Keep the supplied success definition unchanged: peg head x lies in [-0.145,-0.09], y/z satisfy the 0.009 m tolerance, axis alignment is at least 0.985, and the held pose is stable.
overlap_role: Every assigned action is supervised. [1380,1500) overlaps reorient_and_stage_peg by 120 actions or 6 seconds per demonstration (1,440 actions total), including final alignment, descent, and initial engagement.
successor_readiness: There is no learned successor. Continue closed-gripper stabilization until the unchanged success evaluator passes; never use an IK diagnostic alone as completion.
failure_signatures: IK nonconvergence or joint-limit contact after displacement; peg/TCP separation; descent with lateral or angular error; fixture collision; or stalled +hole-x progress. These data do not demonstrate jam recovery.
continuation_guidance: Re-resolve hole_pose and solve IK from fresh measured qpos for every executed slot. If the hole-relative target becomes unreachable or grasp integrity visibly degrades, stop or hand off rather than opening the gripper.
limitations: Hole-frame transport cannot guarantee robot reachability, collision avoidance, grasp retention, or contact recovery. Only nominal successful insertions were observed.
